papers.title_en: LEAP: Accelerating ODE-based Diffusion Sampling with Optimal Linear Leaps
papers.authors: Haowei Zheng, Zhenyu Zhou, Jiawei Chen, Can Wang, Defang Chen
papers.evidence: 通过最优线性跳跃实现免训练扩散采样加速
papers.tldr: 扩散模型常借助通用ODE数值方法实现免训练加速采样，但时间离散较粗时性能明显下降。LEAP从采样轨迹的低维性与跨轨迹一致性出发，在局部轨迹子空间中建立监督最小二乘优化，无需模型评估即可精确逼近未来状态。实验在Stable Diffusion 3.5、FLUX.1-dev文生图及TRELLIS.2图生3D等任务上优于已有方法。该工作还可即插即用地增强现有求解器，为现代扩散模型提供高效采样新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models primarily rely on general-purpose ODE-based numerical methods for training-free accelerated sampling, but performance degrades with coarse time discretization. In this paper, we propose optimal linear leaps (LEAP), a specialized method grounded in theoretical and empirical investigations of sampling trajectory geometry. Built upon low-dimensionality and cross-trajectory consistency, LEAP formulates a supervised least-squares optimization problem within the local trajectory subspace, achieving a precise approximation of future states without model evaluations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LEAP outperforms previous methods across diverse modalities, including text-to-image (Stable Diffusion 3.5, FLUX.1-dev) and image-to-3D (TRELLIS.2) generation. Furthermore, LEAP can be seamlessly integrated into existing solver-based methods, offering a plug-and-play enhancement for modern diffusion models. Code is available at https://github.com/zju-pi/LEAP.

papers.title_en: GeoART: Geometry-Aware Refinement via Test-Time Scaling for Camera-Conditioned Video Diffusion
papers.evidence: 免训练测试时缩放框架，无需微调即提升相机条件视频扩散
papers.tldr: 相机条件视频扩散模型常因去噪过程中相机约束与估计几何约束较弱，导致相机控制不准、几何不一致，现有方法多依赖昂贵的几何微调或额外3D监督。GeoART提出无需训练的自精炼框架，在选定去噪步以Predict-and-Perturb生成多候选并用几何先验评估，经置信门控与秩校准概率选择更新状态。实验在相机可控性、多视图一致性与视觉质量上稳定优于现有采样及自精炼方法。该工作以测试时缩放实现几何感知精炼，无需训练或改动预训练模型。
papers.abstract_en: Camera-conditioned video diffusion models often suffer from inaccurate camera control and geometric inconsisten- cies because camera constraints and estimated geometry are only weakly enforced during denoising. Existing reme- dies often require costly geometry-aware fine-tuning or ad- ditional 3D supervision. We introduce GeoART, a training- free self-refinement framework that improves camera con- trollability through geometry-aware test-time scaling. At selected denoising steps, GeoART generates multiple can- didates within the Predict-and-Perturb cycle and eval- uates them using a geometry prior, without directly modify- ing the denoising trajectory. A confidence gate suppresses unreliable geometric evidence, while rank-calibrated prob- abilistic selection combines score magnitude and relative rank to choose the next refinement state. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in camera controlla- bility, multi-view consistency, and visual quality over exist- ing sampling and self-refinement methods, without training or modifying the pretrained video diffusion model

papers.title_en: PoSTCache: From Forecasting to Postdictive Smoothing for Revisable Diffusion Caching
papers.authors: Liwei Lan, Hui Chen, Jungong Han, Guiguang Ding
papers.evidence: 免训练即插即用的扩散缓存加速
papers.tldr: 扩散与流匹配模型生成质量高但迭代采样开销大，缓存加速虽免训练却多采用单向信息流，跳过步近似一经提交便无法利用后续全计算反馈。PoSTCache将缓存重构为可修订轨迹推断：先用现有策略生成前向提案，再在后续全计算步用预测差异反向校正并重整合先前结果；同时提出PVR，按代理轨迹不确定性预期下降选择锚点。图像与视频生成实验显示，该方法持续改善质量—效率权衡，为免训练、即插即用的扩散缓存提供可修订新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow matching models achieve impressive visual generation quality but remain computationally expensive due to iterative sampling. Caching-based acceleration provides a practical training-free solution by reusing or predicting intermediate features. However, existing methods largely enforce a forward-only information flow: approximations produced for skipped model evaluations are immediately committed to the sampling trajectory and cannot benefit from feedback generated by later full-computation steps. We propose \textbf{PoSTCache} (\emph{Postdictive Smoothing Trajectory Cache}), a training-free and plug-and-play framework that reformulates diffusion caching as revisable trajectory inference. PoSTCache first uses an existing caching strategy to construct forward proposals for skipped steps. At a later full-computation step, the discrepancy between the refreshed prediction and its forward proposal yields a correction signal, which PoSTCache propagates backward to refine and reintegrate the preceding predictions. Viewing full-computation steps as sources of corrective feedback also changes how they should be selected. We therefore introduce the Posterior Variance Reduction (PVR) strategy, which estimates cross-timestep dependencies from offline denoising trajectories and selects anchors according to their expected reduction in surrogate trajectory uncertainty rather than local approximation error alone. Experiments on representative image and video generation models show that PoSTCache consistently improves the quality--efficiency trade-off over representative caching methods.

papers.title_en: Sparsity Should Be ALLOTted by Output: Training-Free Allocation of Block-Sparse Attention for Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Tianze Xia, Xiaoling Zhou, Ruya Lan, Yiqiao Liao, Chengru Song, Shiming Xiang
papers.evidence: 视频扩散Transformer的免训练稀疏分配
papers.tldr: 视频扩散 Transformer 的完整 3D 注意力开销高，块稀疏注意力虽能降本，但现有方法多依赖启发式或局部指标分配稀疏度，未优化层与去噪步的差异。ALLOT 将每个层-步对视为单元，通过单元探测和轨迹校准估计其对最终视频误差的贡献，并在实测延迟预算下联合优化各单元密度，且无需训练。它保持原有选择策略与内核，仅替换分配模块；在 HunyuanVideo 上以 XAttention 取得 11.8 dB PSNR 增益，并在九个设置中优于或持平默认方案。
papers.abstract_en: Full 3D attention is costly in video Diffusion Transformers. Block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only selected attention blocks. However, existing methods either overlook the potential to optimize sparsity allocation or rely on heuristic rules or local metrics to guide it. In this work, we observe that sparsifying attention in different layers and at different denoising steps affects final-video fidelity to substantially different degrees. Yet the identities of the most sensitive layer-step pairs remain nearly unchanged across inputs. Building on these findings, we propose Allocating Layer-step Latency by Output Tests (ALLOT), a training-free sparsity allocation method. Treating each layer-step pair as a cell, ALLOT estimates each cell's contribution to final-video error through (i) cell probing and (ii) trajectory calibration, then jointly optimizes cell densities under a measured-latency budget. It preserves existing selection strategies and kernels, replacing only the allocation component. At equal or shorter wall-clock time, ALLOT outperforms every compared allocation strategy with XAttention, with an 11.8 dB PSNR gain on HunyuanVideo. Extensive experiments across four additional published pipelines on Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo show that ALLOT outperforms or ties the default in all nine settings.

papers.title_en: Latent Space Jam: Layout Guided Video Synthesis
papers.authors: Asaf Joseph, Moshe Mandel, Ohad Fried
papers.evidence: 免训练的视频生成控制
papers.tldr: 视频生成加入布局控制通常需要额外训练，增加算力、数据或架构改动。本文提出免训练两阶段方法，利用预训练视频扩散模型：先通过提示引导的交叉注意力生成粗粒度时空布局视觉引导，再让同一模型据此生成高质量且布局一致的视频。实验在静态、动态和多目标场景中取得更优的重叠与轨迹精度及视觉质量。该方法无需额外训练即可支持多样轨迹和物体交互，为可控视频合成提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Adding control to video generation often requires training, which demands additional computational resources, data, or architectural changes. We propose a training-free approach that utilizes pretrained video diffusion models to control object layout and motion using coarse layouts. Our method operates in two passes: first, it steers spatiotemporal placement through prompt-guided cross-attention to produce a coarse visual guide; second, this guide conditions the same model to generate a high-quality, layoutconsistent video. The approach enables coordinated motion with strong temporal consistency, supporting diverse trajectories and object interactions without additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently outperforms prior work in overlap and trajectory accuracy, as well as visual quality across static, dynamic, and multi-object scene settings.

papers.title_en: ParaLin++: Accelerating Parallel Diffusion Integrator via Intrinsic Partially Linear Structure
papers.authors: Jianrong Lu, Zhiyu Zhu, Hui Liu, Junhui Hou
papers.evidence: 系统评估扩散模型的免训练少步采样加速方法
papers.tldr: 现有免训练少步采样器在FID/CLIP类指标下常被认为近乎无损，但在GenEval、DPG-Bench、LongTextBench等复杂基准上会出现明显质量下降。并行采样因保留全步离散化、仅去除求解器时间依赖而成为例外。为此提出ParaLin++，一种步数对齐的并行采样器，在加速迭代的同时维持全步Euler质量。实验在Stable Diffusion-v2、LSUN Church、FLUX.1-dev和Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0上取得2.6–4.8倍、1.68倍和1.21倍加速，并保持近无损质量。
papers.abstract_en: Training-free few-step samplers are often described as nearly quality-lossless under conventional FID/CLIP-style evaluation. It remains unclear whether that conclusion transfers to more realistic and complex generation-quality benchmarks. We first systematize the quality metrics used to evaluate training-free sampling acceleration for diffusion and flow-matching models.   We find that representative training-free step-shortening methods often remain nearly lossless under FID/CLIP-class metrics, yet can suffer substantial quality degradation when evaluated with semantic-composition, dense-instruction, and long-text-rendering benchmarks such as GenEval, DPG-Bench, and LongTextBench. Parallel sampling is a notable exception: by retaining the full-step discretization and removing only the solver's temporal dependency, it can preserve near-lossless quality while accelerating sampling. Building on this observation, we propose \textit{ParaLin++}, a step-parity parallel sampler that preserves the full-step discretization while accelerating the solver iterations. Experiments across Stable Diffusion-v2, LSUN Church, FLUX.1-dev, and Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 show that ParaLin++ preserves the full-step Euler quality profile at $2.6\times$--$4.8\times$, $1.68\times$ on FLUX, and $1.21\times$ on Ming. Project page: https://paralinplus.github.io/.

papers.title_en: Frequency-Step Cache: Separating Synchronization and Repair for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Kerry Xu, Param Misra, Zachary Stenglein, Athri Karunamurthy, Fanjiang Ye, Yuke Wang
papers.evidence: 面向高效自回归视频扩散的免训练缓存
papers.tldr: 自回归视频扩散需反复前向计算，训练无关缓存虽能加速，却常把精确同步与计算修复耦合在一起。FSC将二者分离：用稠密到稀疏的精确锚点调度，并以频率漂移和token年龄构建潜在风险，决定整步回放、选择性重算或完全修复。在SkyReels-V2上，FSC-Speed达2.36倍加速且SSIM提升0.019，FSC-Quality在同速下SSIM提升0.031。该设计在多种骨干上改善速度-质量权衡，并可免调参迁移至14B模型。
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) video generation enables long-horizon synthesis but requires repeated forward passes through large diffusion transformers. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing intermediate computation, yet existing controllers often couple two decisions: when to synchronize the cache exactly and how much computation to repair between synchronizations. We introduce Frequency-Step Cache (FSC), which separates these roles. FSC schedules exact full-computation anchors on a dense-to-sparse trajectory, while a lightweight latent-space risk based on frequency-resolved drift and token age controls inter-anchor repair through whole-step replay, selective token recomputation, or full repair. On SkyReels-V2, whole-step reuse provides most of the acceleration, while selective token computation is most effective as fidelity repair. A controlled ablation shows that using one reactive signal for both synchronization and repair reduces fidelity at matched latency, with the same separation advantage observed on FramePack and Matrix-Game. Across multiple autoregressive video backbones, FSC improves speed-quality trade-offs. On SkyReels-V2, FSC-Speed reaches 2.36x speedup versus MotionCache's 2.275x while improving SSIM by 0.019 and PSNR by 0.5 dB. At MotionCache-matched speed, FSC-Quality improves SSIM by 0.031 and PSNR by 1.0 dB and lowers LPIPS by 0.024. Without retuning, FSC-Quality transfers to SkyReels-V2 14B at 2.12x speedup versus 1.79x for MotionCache.

papers.title_en: Risk-Averse Inference-Time Diffusion Model Alignment with Finite-Sample Guarantees
papers.evidence: 无需昂贵微调的推理时扩散模型对齐
papers.tldr: 扩散模型推理时对齐无需微调，但现有方法多优化期望代价或奖励，忽略尾部风险。本文提出风险厌恶对齐框架，在轨迹级KL正则下权衡期望代价与CVaR，并将对齐化为对阈值的单维优化。作者给出最优路径分布与反向转移的刻画，分析非凸性、凸性条件及二次正则下的无导数三分搜索，并建立有限样本保证。实验在合成数据和Stable Diffusion上改善尾部表现，同时保持有竞争力的平均代价。
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time alignment steers diffusion models toward downstream objectives without costly fine-tuning, but existing methods typically optimize expected cost (or reward) without explicitly controlling tail risk. In this work, we propose a risk-averse framework for inference-time alignment of diffusion models that balances expected cost and Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) under trajectory-level Kullback-Leibler regularization. We characterize the optimal path distribution and reverse transitions as functions of the CVaR threshold, reducing the alignment problem to a one-dimensional optimization problem over the threshold. We show that this one-dimensional optimization problem can be nonconvex in general, establish sufficient conditions for convexity, and introduce quadratic regularization to enable efficient derivative-free ternary search. Under suitable assumptions, we provide finite-sample guarantees for threshold optimization and value estimation, and combine them into a terminal total-variation bound relative to the regularized target under exact resampling. Experiments on synthetic data and image generation using Stable Diffusion demonstrate improved tail performance over risk-neutral baselines while maintaining competitive average cost.

papers.title_en: QK-Edit: Revisiting Attention-based Injection in MM-DiT for Image and Video Editing
papers.authors: Tiancheng Shen, Zilong Huang, Xiangtai Li, Zhijie Lin, Jiyang Liu, Yitong Wang, Jiashi Feng, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jun Hao Liew
papers.evidence: 面向图像视频编辑的免训练注意力操控
papers.tldr: MM-DiT 通过多模态自注意力统一图文生成，但传统 U-Net 注意力编辑手段难以适用。QK-Edit 提出免训练框架，利用查询-键注意力操纵隔离并调整关键注意力分量，在提示保真与结构一致间取得平衡。方法可经推理期特征替换实现，在 FLUX 与 HunyuanVideo 上完成增删改物体、换背景材质颜色及风格转换等编辑并表现优越。该工作弥合 MM-DiT 生成能力与可编辑灵活性之间的差距，为可扩展多模态内容创作铺路。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for unified text-vision synthesis, surpassing traditional U-Net architectures in generative tasks. One key innovation lies in its Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) interaction, where image and text tokens are concatenated and processed via self-attention. However, this mechanism poses significant challenges for editing, rendering conventional U-Net-based attention manipulation methods ineffective. To address this limitation, we propose QK-Edit, a training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiTs for precise text-guided image and video editing. By introducing a novel query-key manipulation strategy, our method isolates and adjusts critical attention components to achieve an optimal balance between prompt fidelity and structural consistency. This enables seamless edits across various tasks, including object addition, object removal, object replacement, changing background, changing material, changing color, and style transformation. Notably, it can be easily implemented with feature replacement in inference. QK-Edit demonstrates superior editing performance on state-of-the-art models, such as FLUX and HunyuanVideo, effectively bridging the gap between generative power and editable flexibility in MM-DiTs, and paving the way for scalable multimodal content creation.

papers.title_en: QK-Edit: Revisiting Attention-based Injection in MM-DiT for Image and Video Editing
papers.authors: Tiancheng Shen, Zilong Huang, Xiangtai Li, Zhijie Lin, Jiyang Liu, Yitong Wang, Jiashi Feng, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jun Hao Liew
papers.evidence: 面向图像与视频编辑的免训练框架
papers.tldr: 多模态扩散Transformer（MM-DiT）虽提升统一文图生成，但其MM-SA机制使传统U-Net编辑方法失效。QK-Edit提出免训练框架，通过查询-键注意力操控隔离并调整关键注意力分量。方法在FLUX与HunyuanVideo上实现对象增删改、背景/材质/颜色与风格编辑，兼顾提示忠实度与结构一致性。该工作弥合MM-DiT生成能力与可编辑灵活性之间的差距。

One key innovation lies in its Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) interaction, where image and text tokens are concatenated and processed via self-attention. papers.title_en: BridgeTwist: Twisting Schrödinger Bridges for Training-Free Conditional Sampling
papers.authors: Mengyu Li, Qianqian Qu, Jun S. Liu
papers.evidence: 预训练薛定谔桥模型的免训练条件采样器
papers.tldr: 现有无训练条件采样多面向扩散/流模型，预训练 Schrödinger bridge 仍缺对应方法。BridgeTwist 将其表述为带温度 twist 的顺序蒙特卡洛，用闭式端点预测器构造似然代理，并按时间衰减早期 twist。还设计桥形推理噪声调度，使重要性权重 telescoping 抵消中间因子。实验在类条件与文本图像生成优于无训练基线，并在修复、去模糊、超分上具竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Generative models are often required to serve many downstream conditional tasks. In the training-free setting, a pretrained unconditional model is reused as a prior and combined with a task-specific likelihood to sample from the corresponding posterior. While such training-free samplers have been developed for diffusion and flow models, their counterpart for Schrödinger bridge (SB) models remains unexplored, despite the growing appeal of SBs as flexible stochastic transport models between general source and target distributions. We propose BridgeTwist, a training-free conditional sampler for pretrained SB generative models, formulated as a tempered twisted sequential Monte Carlo scheme. Its twist is a closed-form plug-in surrogate, obtained by combining the velocity and score fields exposed by SB pretraining into an endpoint predictor and evaluating the likelihood there. Since this surrogate is less reliable near the source, we temper the twist with a time-varying exponent, downweighting its influence at early steps. We further introduce a bridge-shaped inference-time diffusion schedule that concentrates the proposal noise in the interior of the path. Telescoping importance weights then cancel all intermediate twist factors, yielding an asymptotically exact sampler for the posterior. Empirically, BridgeTwist outperforms training-free baselines on class-conditional and text-prompted image generation, and is competitive with specialized inverse problem solvers on inpainting, deblurring, and super-resolution.

papers.title_en: ReState: Noise-Level-Aware State Correction for Training-Free Object Removal in Few-Step Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Donghwan Lee, Sanghyun Jo, Sihyun Kim, Ziseok Lee, Kyungsu Kim
papers.evidence: 通过状态校正在少步扩散模型中免训练去除物体
papers.tldr: 免训练目标移除通常依靠重新引导自注意力绕开目标区域，但在少步蒸馏扩散模型上会残留物体形状的痕迹。作者指出这是时间错配：掩码内的结构化预测在首次前向就已形成，后续修正机会很少。ReState 用噪声水平感知的权重，把掩码内的干净预测向背景证据校正，该权重在最终前向时归零，并保留排除物体的注意力作为补充约束。该方法在两个配对基准和两个少步骨干上取得免训练方法中最好的掩码 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS，平均比最强基线提升 3.17 dB，且不增加去噪器评估次数。
papers.abstract_en: Training-free object removal commonly redirects self-attention away from the target region, but on few-step distilled diffusion models this often leaves object-shaped residuals. We identify a temporal mismatch: a structured prediction forms inside the mask at the first forward, and the short trajectory offers few later chances to revise it, while attention rerouting acts mainly in later steps. Across four distilled backbones, magnitude-matched single-forward interventions show that background-directed state correction affects the final result more than attention rerouting. We therefore propose ReState, which corrects the masked clean prediction toward background evidence retrieved from the input using a noise-level-aware weight that vanishes at the final forward. ReState retains object-excluding attention as a complementary constraint and adds no denoiser evaluations. Across two paired benchmarks and two few-step backbones, ReState achieves the best masked PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among training-free methods, improving PSNR by 3.17 dB on average over the strongest baseline. On OBER-Test, it also outperforms the 50-step attention-forcing reference on all three metrics at 6.7x lower latency. The same configuration transfers to two additional distilled backbones without retuning. Project page: https://tdrlee.github.io/ReState

papers.title_en: Negation without Confusion: Decomposing Bias and Recomposing Style in Text Embeddings for Negation-aware Image Generation
papers.authors: Sooyeon Park, Hemraj Singh, Kyunghyun Min, Youngjae Yu, Sung-Bae Cho
papers.evidence: 面向否定感知图像生成的免训练文本嵌入分解重组
papers.tldr: 文本到图像扩散模型常因文本表征中隐含的语言偏置而难以处理否定语义，偏置对齐内容会压过否定约束。为此，作者提出免训练的Dero方法，利用辅助提示构建语义保持子空间与偏置子空间，并通过双向SVD分解纠缠表征，再选择性重组语义分量与残差风格特征。该方法仅作用于文本表征，可即插即用于U-Net与DiT等扩散架构。实验在物体级和概念级否定任务上均取得更优文图对齐、语义保真度与人类偏好。
papers.abstract_en: Negation-aware image generation remains challenging for text-to-image diffusion models, which often struggle with negation due to implicit linguistic biases that are deeply entangled within text representations. As a result, bias-aligned semantics frequently dominate over intended negative constraints. To overcome this limitation, we propose a simple training-free method of Decompose and Recompose text embedding (Dero), which constructs a semantic-preserving subspace and a bias subspace using auxiliary prompts and performs semantic disentanglement based on bidirectional SVD. By decomposing entangled representations and selectively recomposing disentangled semantic components, Dero realigns text representations toward intended negation semantics while restoring residual stylistic features to preserve semantic fidelity and image quality. As a model-agnostic inference-time framework operating solely on text representations, Dero can be seamlessly applied to diverse diffusion architectures, including both U-Net and DiT based models. Extensive experiments on both object- and concept-level negation demonstrate consistent improvements in negation-aware image generation, achieving stronger text-image alignment, better semantic fidelity, and higher human preference scores.

papers.title_en: Internal Guidance as a Sampling Method for Tilted Diffusion Models
papers.evidence: 面向倾斜扩散模型的免训练内部引导采样
papers.tldr: 奖励引导常通过外部加性或乘性项采样扩散模型的倾斜分布，但会引入额外引导项且需针对任务调整。本文提出内部引导：不修改基础去噪器输出，而是改变其评估输入点；对超立方体离散分布，线性倾斜密度的去噪器等价于基础去噪器在平移缩放输入上的取值。为覆盖所需分布外评估点，训练时对数据做随机对角缩放，使单一去噪网络无需微调即可采样二值奖励倾斜、类别标签和填充。该方法为倾斜扩散采样提供了统一且无需外部引导项的新途径。
papers.abstract_en: Reward guidance methods sample an exponential tilt of a base density using a diffusion model trained with only samples from the base distribution. Existing methods use what we call external guidance: additive terms in the drift or multiplicative terms on the transition probabilities. We propose internal guidance which leaves the output of the base denoiser unmodified and instead changes the point at which it is evaluated. For discrete distributions embedded in the hypercube $\{-1,1\}^{d}$, the denoiser of any linearly tilted density is exactly the base denoiser evaluated at a shifted and rescaled input. In practice the base denoiser is a neural network trained on noised samples of the base distribution. The required evaluation points for sampling the tilted density would be out-of-distribution for basic noising of the base distribution. We modify the training algorithm with random diagonal rescalings of the data, so that the denoiser network learns both in- and out-of-distribution evaluations of the denoiser relative to the base distribution. A single denoiser network samples binary reward tilts, class labels, and infilling with no fine-tuning and no external guidance term.

papers.title_en: Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Yushi Lan, Zeren Jiang, Koichi Namekata, Xingang Pan, Chuanxia Zheng, Andrea Vedaldi
papers.evidence: 用四维重建脚手架引导预训练视频扩散模型，无需微调
papers.tldr: 从新相机轨迹合成单目视频时，既要保持已观测场景的几何与运动，又要补全新可见区域。Holo4D 用前馈4D重建器恢复的3D轨迹作为整体源视角4D支架，投影到目标视角并编码几何与源外观，引导预训练视频扩散模型。该方法把生成锚定在重建观测上，未被支撑区域交给生成先验，实验显示轨迹条件对相机控制和新视角合成有效。
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing a monocular video from a new camera trajectory requires preserving the observed scene geometry and motion while completing regions that become newly visible. Feed-forward 4D reconstructors recover the structure of the observed scene, whereas video diffusion models provide a generative prior for completing unseen content. We introduce Holo4D, a video reshooting framework that uses reconstructed 3D trajectories as a holistic source-view 4D scaffold. We project these trajectories into the requested views and encode their geometry and source appearance to guide a pretrained video diffusion model. Together with the source video and target cameras, the scaffold grounds generation in reconstructed observations while leaving unsupported regions to the generative prior. Experiments demonstrate the value of trajectory-based conditioning for camera control and novel-view synthesis. The framework accommodates different 4D reconstructors without retraining the video generator, allowing it to benefit from future advances in source reconstruction. More details can be found in our project page.

papers.title_en: ATLAS: Attention-Guided Test-Time Latent Selection for Compositional Visual Autoregressive Generation
papers.authors: Hossein Shahabadi, Raya Namazi, Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah
papers.evidence: 面向图像生成的免训练测试时潜变量选择，但基于自回归而非扩散模型
papers.tldr: 视觉自回归模型能生成逼真图像，却常错配属性与空间关系，完整评估多条生成路径代价高昂。ATLAS 是免训练框架，利用冻结生成器内部注意力在出图前预测组合偏好，并逐步把算力集中到有希望的轨迹。它保留多候选、在中间尺度无解码剪枝，仅对部分轨迹做最终图像空间选择。在 T2I-CompBench 和 GenEval 上，平均分随搜索预算提升，最大预算下目标指标较各骨干提升逾10%，同时降低生成时间与显存峰值。
papers.abstract_en: Visual autoregressive models produce convincing images but can misassign attributes and spatial relations. Searching multiple generation paths can improve composition, yet completing every candidate is costly. We introduce ATLAS, a training-free framework that uses the frozen generator's internal attention to guide search before final images are available. Within-prompt diagnostics identify attention-derived scores that predict final compositional preferences on Infinity, with category-dependent transfer to Switti. ATLAS uses these on-the-fly signals to progressively concentrate computation on promising trajectories. It maintains multiple coarse alternatives, prunes candidates without decoding at intermediate scales, and reserves image-space evaluation for a final choice among partial trajectories. ATLAS scales effectively on both backbones, achieving higher mean scores on the evaluated T2I-CompBench and GenEval categories as more computation is devoted to search. At the largest tested budget, the targeted T2I-CompBench mean improves by over 10% relative to each backbone. Separate profiles show over 50% less generation time than completing and evaluating all candidates at equal initial counts, alongside lower peak allocated GPU memory. Relative time savings are larger at the higher tested candidate count. Together, these results support scalable compositional search: additional sampling expands exploration, while attention-guided selection limits continuation cost without parameter updates or gradient-based optimization.

papers.title_en: TamedFlow: Trajectory-Aware Distillation\\for Teacher-Assisted Diffusion Sampling
papers.authors: Shuaiqi Cheng, Jiahao Zhang, Boyuan Gu, Siyu You, Yuxi Chen, Haiying Xu, Zexin Lu, Huiyu Zhou, Xuming Hu
papers.evidence: 面向图像与视频生成的扩散采样加速，但依赖蒸馏训练
papers.tldr: Diffusion Transformer 推理需多次顺序评估，压缩与自适应推理结合时会出现“组合鸿沟”，直接套用会降低质量。TamedFlow 通过跨架构特征对齐、近恒等速度对齐头和随机 rollout 监督训练压缩学生模型，并用可学习轨迹估计器路由草稿、拒绝时回滚并由教师救援一步。将 DiT-XL/2 蒸馏到 DiT-B/2，在 ImageNet 256×256 上 FID 2.58，较 DDIM-50 实测加速 2.25×。该工作把轨迹感知蒸馏用于教师辅助采样，缓解组合失效并扩展至多数据集验证。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver high-fidelity image and video generation, but inference requires many sequential model evaluations. Two acceleration strategies are increasingly important: model compression makes each evaluation cheaper, while adaptive inference avoids selected teacher computation through reuse, forecasting, or speculative execution. Their combination, however, is brittle: directly applying the evaluated adaptive methods to a compressed student can degrade quality, an observed failure mode we call the \textbf{Combination Gap}. We link this gap to a mismatch between pointwise distillation and short-horizon execution: a student trained at teacher states need not remain reliable when its own predictions are chained. We propose \textbf{TamedFlow}, which trains a compressed DiT for this deployed role through cross-architecture feature alignment, a near-identity Velocity Alignment Head, and randomized rollout supervision. At inference, a lightweight Learnable Trajectory Estimator routes completed drafts: accepted drafts bypass the teacher, while rejected drafts roll back and receive one teacher rescue step. Distilling DiT-XL/2 into DiT-B/2, TamedFlow reaches FID $2.58$ at $2.25\times$ measured speedup over DDIM-50 on ImageNet $256\times256$. Ablations support trajectory supervision, and routing controls favor LTE over random decisions at nearly matched latency. Evaluations on ImageNet $512\times512$, MS-COCO, and Latte/FaceForensics extend the empirical scope.
